steps.prompt: Before the check: which circle fact feels most like a tool you can use without thinking?

cards.title: Angles, tangents and power: quick review
cards.body: Inscribed angle $= \frac{1}{2}$ arc; semicircle $90^\circ$; cyclic quadrilateral opposite angles add to $180^\circ$. Tangent $\perp$ radius; equal tangents. $PA \cdot PB = PC \cdot PD$; $PT^2 = PA \cdot PB$; inside, $r^2 - d^2$.

cards.title: Circles in triangles and areas: quick review
cards.body: $r = \frac{\text{area}}{s}$; right triangle $r = \frac{a + b - c}{2}$, $R = \frac{c}{2}$; $R = \frac{abc}{4K}$. Sector $\frac{\theta}{360}\pi r^2$, arc $\frac{\theta}{360} 2\pi r$; segment = sector $-$ triangle.

cards.title: How the check works
cards.body: First a short warm-up. Then the check: $8$ AMC-style problems with choices, easiest first, no hints. You need all $8$ right (100%) to pass. If you miss one, you'll see the solutions and which skills to review, and the next try gives you new problems.

prompts: Which habit from this unit will you use first on your next test?
Which skill will you keep practising in the daily review?
